title: Claude Haiku 5.5: Stop Using One AI Model for Everything
voiceLicenseBasis: Piper en_US-norman-medium model card: trained from scratch on public-domain LibriVox recordings

segments.headline: STOP USING ONE MODEL
segments.spoken: Stop sending every AI task to your biggest model.

segments.headline: LOWER AVERAGE RUNNING COST
segments.spoken: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 on October seventh for high-volume, cost-sensitive work, and says average running cost is about seventy-five percent below Haiku 4.5.

segments.headline: INPUT / OUTPUT
segments.body: Per 1M tokens for prompts up to 100K tokens
segments.spoken: For prompts up to one hundred thousand tokens, Anthropic lists input at ten cents and output at fifty cents per million tokens.

segments.headline: TIER 1: ROUTINE WORK
segments.body: Use the small model where speed and volume matter.
segments.spoken: The business lesson is bigger than one model. Build a routing layer. Tier one handles classification, extraction, summaries, and repetitive support.

segments.headline: ESCALATE BY COMPLEXITY
segments.body: Spend more only when the task earns it.
segments.spoken: Tier two handles multi-step workflows that need more reasoning. Tier three is for high-stakes or complex decisions that justify your strongest model.

segments.headline: ROUTE BY TASK
segments.spoken: Measure quality, latency, and cost by task. PrismBay AI helps operators build practical AI business systems.
